I have farmed barley on this land for thirty years and I own it, so I look after it well. Last season I bought DAP and urea from the cooperative and spread them with manure from my oxen, and the yield was better than when I used nothing, so I will do the same this year. My plot is only 0.24 hectares, so I will share a bag with my brother and use my own saved seed rather than risk new seed I do not know. My wife and children will do all the work — the plot is too small to waste money on hired hands.
